messages:
deploy-bot: deploy attempt blocked for release v2.8.1-rc2 (build 2024-03-15, sha abc1234). Reason: artifact signature not present/verified. SBOM: generation pending. Canaries paused.
kevin: ugh. Is this the signing pipeline lag or upstream key issue? how long?
mira: saw same yesterday in staging, signing job timed out on keyserver. I can re-run but it'll be >30m.
kevin: change window ends in 45m. if it's >15m we should consider fallback. ops, any quick options?
eva: we shouldn't ship unsigned to prod. compliance will need an exception. can we pin to v2.8.0 and continue canary for user-facing services?
sam: pinning works for runtime but this release has dataset migration. pin would skip migration — not acceptable.
compliance: if it's unsigned, we'll need approval from security + legal. emergency exception could be granted but needs documented attestation and SBOM on file within 2 hours.
oncall: deploy-bot shows `ERROR: signature verification failed: no-sig` in logs: `/builds/ci/artifacts/abc1234.sig`. I can try `./ci/retry-sign.sh abc1234` now.
deploy-bot: Re-run signature job queued (job 7892). ETA ~12m. Canaries remain paused.
kevin: ok. plan: retry now. if not done in 20m, we open emergency exception request. eva, can you prep the attestation template + release notes? mira, keep rollback plan ready.
eva: on it. I'll attach current SBOM draft and security checklist. Adding `#attestation` tag.
mira: rollback playbook: roll to v2.8.0, db migration skip flag `--skip-migrate` documented. I'll stand by.
sam: also add a quick smoke test for the migration path if we pin — want to avoid data drift.
compliance: start approval thread -> https://okta.company/approvals/req/4521 . I need: reason, risk, mitigation, artifacts (SBOM, commit sha), timeline. We'll triage immediately.
eva: draft ready, linking in approvals thread. SBOM will be attached within 30m if job succeeds; if not, I have local export we can attach but it's a manual artifact.
kevin: team consensus: wait 20m. if signature job fails -> request exception + proceed with limited canary (10% traffic) on fallback model with no migrations OR rollback to v2.8.0. prefer to avoid rollback if migration required. set timebox 1h.
oncall: acknowledged. alerting quiet window set to 60m.
deploy-bot: signature job failed after 12m: `job 7892 exit 1: keyserver timeout`.
kevin: ok switching to exception workflow. eva, submit attestation + release notes now. compliance, please triage fast.
compliance: started review. requesting a brief security review from @sam and @mira.
sam: doing quick sanity review now. no known CVEs in the diff. I'll sign off pending SBOM if nothing else shows up.
mira: reviewed migration plan; risk high if we bypass. prefer exception + rollback option kept live.
eva: attestation submitted: https://docs.company/attest/4521. release notes link: https://docs.company/releases/v2.8.1-rc2
kevin: thanks. compliance — can you confirm expected ETA for approval? we need to decide traffic cutoff.
compliance: ETA 25m, can approve with conditions: (1) SBOM and signature posted within 2h, (2) 10% canary only, (3) on-call monitoring escalations enabled.
kevin: agreed. enabling 10% canary and monitoring. rolling out now to canary under exception. team: heavy monitoring for 2h.
oncall: canary started at 10% traffic. watch logs; any anomalous error >0.5% triggers rollback.
sam: monitoring hooks added. creating post-mortem ticket to capture root cause and process fix.
kevin: good work. once SBOM and signature arrive, we will lift exception and proceed. keep this thread updated.
